children: MultiversX's Supernova release goes live on mainnet on September 10 at 17:45 UTC, arriving as the network's newest release after earlier devnet and testnet rollouts. The activation applies directly to EGLD, as Supernova moves from staged testing environments onto the production chain.

Supernova's progression through devnet and testnet before mainnet means the activated code has already been exercised in staged environments, so the mainnet step is a deployment milestone rather than an untested change. With the release live, attention shifts to how validators and applications absorb the upgraded protocol capabilities, and market participants may reposition around those changes as the activation date arrives.
Excited to announce our newest model!

title: MultiversX: Supernova Network Release Goes Live on Mainnet - 10 Sep 2026
